scientific_context.purpose: Increase the density and diversity of candidate-level pre-election evidence without assigning subjective scores or changing F0.

existing_medias24_surface.interpretation: This is the canonical candidate/territory discovery surface. It is evidence-layer coverage, not calibrated predictive signal.

user_supplied_workbooks.role: Human-seeded discovery ledger for party switches, incumbency and local-office leads. The workbook is not evidence by itself.
Methodology inspiration only. Subjective scores, hand-set weights and seat probabilities are explicitly excluded from ingestion.

transfuge_workbook_audit.rule: All 24 rows remain discovery leads until source-level verification. Rows based only on Le360, TelQuel, Maghreb Intelligence or other disallowed media are quarantined under E_collect V1 source policy.

feature_bridge.verification_rule: T0, or T1 official party source plus independent MEDIAS24/T0 corroboration.
Resolve historical identity, current party and territory independently; unknown remains NA.

feature_bridge.external_concept: president/vice-president de commune ou region / elu local
feature_bridge.verification_rule: Objective named elected office only; no subjective notability score.

feature_bridge.external_concept: fonction nationale ou regionale de parti
feature_bridge.verification_rule: Official party organ or permitted corroborated source with dated office identity.

explicit_exclusions: No national-dynamics score duplicated across constituencies
No seat probability generated from this addendum
No candidate claim accepted solely because it appears in a user workbook

power_implication.conclusion: Candidate identity coverage is no longer the primary bottleneck. The remaining bottleneck is converting candidate records into independently verified, historically backtestable directional features with enough variation and true/false support.

next_action: Verify and adjudicate the human-seeded party-switch/incumbency/local-office leads against allowed T0/T1/MEDIAS24 sources, then run an information-density/power audit before any new E_reason or forecast update.
